entities.name: Agibot
entities.summary: 智元机器人 (Zhiyuan Robotics). Shanghai humanoid-robot startup founded 2023 by ex-Huawei engineer 彭志辉 (稚晖君). One of the two most-valuable Chinese humanoid-robot startups (alongside Unitree). ~USD 6 bn post-money in Feb-2026 strategic round. Ships full-size and mid-size humanoids (远征 series, 灵犀 series), the open-source GO-1 VLA foundation model and the AgiBot World dataset.

entities.name: Unitree
entities.summary: 宇树科技. Hangzhou-based leading global quadruped-robot maker; G1 humanoid starts at USD 16k. Filed A-share IPO guidance in Jul-2025. Closest direct competitor to Agibot.

entities.name: UBTECH
entities.summary: 优必选 (HKEX:9880). Only listed pure-play humanoid company; Walker S/S2 industrial humanoid deployed at BYD, NIO, Geely, FAW and Foxconn factories since 2024.

entities.name: Figure AI
entities.summary: US humanoid-robot startup, ~USD 39.5 bn post-money in Feb-2025 Series C. Partners with BMW (assembly pilots) and OpenAI/Microsoft for foundation-model integration.

entities.name: Tesla Optimus
entities.summary: Tesla's in-house humanoid-robot project, sell-side implied spin-off valuation USD 20-35 bn. Shares Tesla autopilot labeling and simulator data flywheel; not yet sold externally.

entities.name: Apptronik
entities.summary: US humanoid maker (Apollo robot); ~USD 4 bn valuation on USD 350 m raise Aug-2025. Strong industrial-engineering culture; partners with Mercedes-Benz and GXO Logistics.

entities.name: 1X Technologies
entities.summary: Norway/US humanoid maker (Neo Gamma) targeting the consumer home market — a positioning differentiator vs factory/warehouse-focused peers. Backed by OpenAI.

entities.name: Physical Intelligence
entities.summary: US foundation-model-only humanoid AI lab; π0 / π0.5 VLA models. Most-direct AI peer to Agibot's GO-1 model. ~USD 2.4 bn valuation despite having no hardware product.

entities.name: Sanctuary AI
entities.summary: Canadian humanoid maker, latest disclosed valuation ~USD 0.5 bn.

entities.name: Skild AI
entities.summary: US foundation-model humanoid AI startup; ~USD 4.5 bn Series A valuation Jul-2024.

entities.name: Fourier Intelligence
entities.summary: 傅利叶智能. Early Shanghai humanoid maker; GR-1 launched 2023. Focused on rehab/medical. ~USD 0.8 bn Series E in Oct-2024.

entities.name: Boston Dynamics
entities.summary: Industry pioneer, now Hyundai-owned. Electric Atlas (2024+) shows the most-capable dynamic locomotion of any humanoid but is not sold externally. Commercial focus remains Spot (quadruped) and Stretch (warehouse arm).

entities.name: NVIDIA
entities.summary: Provides the dominant humanoid-robotics simulation stack (Isaac Sim / Isaac Lab) and the GR00T-N1 / N1.5 foundation models — neutral infrastructure that competes with vendor-proprietary models like Agibot GO-1 and Figure Helix.

entities.name: BYD
entities.summary: Largest Chinese EV maker and Agibot's lead industrial pilot customer (multi-site assembly pilots) AND strategic investor. Also has an internal humanoid-robot program.

entities.name: SAIC Motor
entities.summary: 上汽集团. Agibot strategic investor and assembly-pilot customer. Has also separately invested in multiple competing humanoid startups.

entities.name: JD.com
entities.summary: 京东. Strategic investor in Agibot; via subsidiary JD Logistics runs the largest publicly-known pilot of Agibot's 远征 D1 wheeled humanoid in a Beijing fulfilment centre.

entities.name: JD Logistics
entities.summary: 京东物流. JD.com subsidiary; runs the Agibot 远征 D1 picking/sorting pilot in Beijing.

entities.name: BAIC
entities.summary: 北汽. Agibot strategic investor (Feb-2026 round) and announced pilot customer.

entities.name: Foxconn
entities.summary: 鸿海/富士康. Disclosed electronics-assembly pilot customer of Agibot (2025).

entities.name: FAW Group
entities.summary: 一汽. Agibot pilot customer disclosed at WAIC 2025.

entities.name: Geely
entities.summary: 吉利汽车. Pilot customer of Agibot industrial humanoid deployments.

entities.name: State Grid
entities.summary: 国家电网. Pilot customer running Agibot 远征 D1 variant for substation inspection.

entities.name: Shanghai AI Lab
entities.summary: 上海人工智能实验室. Research collaborator and co-author with Agibot on the GO-1 model and related publications.

entities.name: Shanghai Jiao Tong University
entities.summary: 上海交通大学. Research partner and talent pipeline for Agibot; co-founder 闫维新 is an SJTU robotics professor.

entities.name: Lingang Government
entities.summary: 临港新片区政府. Strategic LP investor that supplied land, subsidies and patient capital to Agibot; hosts the company's primary R&D and pilot-line campus.

entities.name: Tencent
entities.summary: Strategic investor in Agibot's 2026 round.

entities.name: Hillhouse Capital
entities.summary: 高瓴资本. Strategic investor in Agibot's 2026 round.

entities.name: HongShan
entities.summary: 红杉中国. Strategic investor in Agibot's 2026 round (formerly Sequoia China).

entities.name: CICC Capital
entities.summary: 中金资本. State-affiliated investor in Agibot's 2026 strategic / Pre-IPO round.

entities.name: GO-1
entities.summary: Genie Operator-1. Agibot's open-source vision-language-action (VLA) foundation model — its flagship AI asset and most-cited differentiator vs Unitree.

entities.name: AgiBot World
entities.summary: World's largest publicly-released humanoid-manipulation dataset (>1 million trajectories collected on Agibot's own teleop fleet). Released on GitHub and Hugging Face.

entities.name: Yuanzheng A2
entities.summary: 远征 A2 (and A2-W wheeled variant). Agibot's full-size humanoid for industrial / research / service customers — flagship hardware line and largest revenue contributor.

entities.name: Lingxi X2
entities.summary: 灵犀 X2. Lower-price humanoid line launched 2025 for universities, content, exhibition and developer-kit customers. Open-sourced predecessor X1 was released Aug-2024.

entities.name: Yuanzheng D1
entities.summary: 远征 D1. Logistics-focused dual-arm wheeled humanoid; running pilot at JD Logistics' Beijing fulfilment centre and at State Grid for substation inspection.

entities.name: Genie A2-Max
entities.summary: 精灵 A2-Max. Research-grade specialised configuration sold under multi-year master contracts to research institutes and tier-1 industrial customers.

entities.name: GR00T-N1
entities.summary: NVIDIA's humanoid foundation-model family (N1 / N1.5); directly competes with Agibot GO-1 and Physical Intelligence π0 as the neutral-infrastructure VLA option.

entities.name: Pi-Zero
entities.summary: π0 / π0.5. Physical Intelligence's VLA foundation model — the AI peer most often benchmarked against Agibot GO-1.

entities.name: Atlas
entities.summary: Boston Dynamics Atlas (electric, 2024+). The most-capable humanoid for dynamic locomotion; not sold externally — a long-horizon project inside Hyundai.
